info.name: TestMu AI SmartUI API Documentation Autoheal Command Logs API
Fetch autohealed commands data for a test

params.name: test_id
params.description: Test ID for which to fetch autohealed commands

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 100)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination (default 0)

items.docs: Retrieve all autohealed commands for a specific test session, including original and healed locators with execution duration.
